turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: How many migraines did you have last month?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Four, which is down from eight.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: It works if I take it early.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No aura. Some vomiting with the bad ones.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.text: Keep a diary and come back in three months.
